text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Killing two birds with one stone. Thanks to you, I've broadened my gaming horizonsand managed to snag an untold multitude of plushies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for making up for my shortcomings.
I truly understand now what the ancient rulers meant by the bond of fish and water."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so... to reward you for your hard work,
I've come up with a top-notch pun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Someone give me the "crane" prize... I beg of you, please!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How's that, a flawless masterpiece, isn't it...?! Don't hold back, laugh your heart out!
